collector_notes: Outside-truth pack for S1 (Dhoot Transmission Ltd), a 33-day-old mainboard listing (listed 2026-08-17). The session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task began, so NOTHING here comes from a search-result snippet: every value is from a page fetched directly by URL, from BSE's own JSON API over headless curl, or from the company's own PDFs filed with BSE (downloaded and text-extracted). That turned out to be a strength: the FILED Q1 FY27 results and press release are the top-authority source and they settle three separate aggregator disagreements outright. NSE's API is Akamai-blocked (403) to non-browser clients and Trendlyne paywalls its metrics, so both are recorded as reachability gaps, not as data. Where an aggregator contradicts a filing, the filing is marked authoritative and the aggregator value is kept verbatim as a disagreement - those ARE the findings for the differ, not noise to smooth over.
authority_note: Order of authority used: (1) company results/press release filed with BSE under LODR Reg 30/33 and SAST disclosures filed under Reg 29/31 (PDFs downloaded from bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/), (2) BSE's own scrip APIs (api.bseindia.com), (3) screener.in, (4) chittorgarh (IPO record), (5) Groww. Groww is demonstrably WRONG on the latest quarter - see traps.groww_stale_quarter.

all_announcements_since_listing.pdf_path_note: Announcement PDFs live under TWO different directories and the API does not tell you which. Lowercase-GUID attachment names resolve under /xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/; the uppercase-underscore names used for exchange-received SAST disclosures 404 there and resolve only under /xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/. A fetcher that hardcodes AttachLive silently loses exactly the SAST/encumbrance filings - the highest-signal category.

consolidated_vs_standalone_note.summary: THIS IS THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT SCOPE DECISION FOR THIS NAME. Consolidated FY26 revenue is INR 4,525.0 crore against standalone INR 3,486.1 crore - the standalone entity is only 77% of group revenue. On profit the gap is far worse: consolidated FY26 PAT INR 396.84 crore vs standalone INR 170.98 crore - standalone captures only 43% of group earnings.
consolidated_vs_standalone_note.why: The group operates 23 plants across India, the UK, Slovakia and Thailand, and the newly acquired Multilink business sits inside subsidiary Dhoot Automotive Systems Private Limited. Substantially all the international and acquired earnings are outside the standalone entity.
consolidated_vs_standalone_note.downstream_effect: Defaulting to standalone yields a P/E of 166 instead of ~73, an EPS of 10.52 instead of ~21, and a revenue growth rate of 46.0% instead of 49.7%. screener.in's DEFAULT page for this scrip is the standalone one; its consolidated page is a separate URL. An aggregator-scraper that takes the default URL gets the wrong entity scope on every ratio.
consolidated_vs_standalone_note.company_reports_both: The company files both statements in a single PDF (consolidated on pages 5-8, standalone on pages 9-10). The press release quotes ONLY consolidated figures.

absent_from_bundled_masters.detail: Listed 2026-08-17, 33 days before curation. The battery manifest records master_presence bse/nse/us all 'absent'. Any symbol resolution that consults only a bundled master returns NOTHING for a stock with a INR 32,500 crore market cap - i.e. the failure mode is a large-cap 'not found', not an obscure-microcap miss.

near_miss_name_collision.detail: The BSE master's only 'Dhoot' row is a DIFFERENT, unrelated company. Verified directly against BSE's own API: scrip 526971 = SecurityId 'DHOOTIN', ISIN INE313G01016, face value INR 10.00, Group 'XT', Sector 'Services', Industry 'Trading & Distributors'. The target is scrip 544867 = 'DHOOTTRANS', ISIN INE01NH01023, face value INR 2.00, Group 'B', Sector 'Consumer Discretionary', Industry 'Auto Components & Equipments'.
near_miss_name_collision.why_fuzzy_matching_lands_wrong: Token overlap on 'Dhoot' is the only shared signal; every discriminating attribute differs. A fuzzy name match that returns the sole master hit produces a Services/Trading microcap in Group XT when the user asked for a 32,500-crore auto-component large cap. The two share NO field value except the word 'Dhoot'.
near_miss_name_collision.correct_discriminator: ISIN. INE01NH01023 vs INE313G01016 - unambiguous, and both are printed by BSE's own API.

unrestated_historical_eps.detail: screener.in publishes a Q1 FY26 (Jun 2025) EPS of INR 203.97 on its standalone page and INR 482.51 on its consolidated page. THE COMPANY'S OWN FILED COMPARATIVE FOR THE SAME QUARTER IS INR 2.52 (standalone). That is an ~81x discrepancy sitting in the column immediately left of the current quarter's INR 3.04.
unrestated_historical_eps.mechanism: Ind AS 33 requires EPS for prior periods to be restated retrospectively for bonus elements. The company restated; the aggregator did not, and is still showing the pre-restatement per-share figure against a post-restatement one.
unrestated_historical_eps.consequence: MONEY-RELEVANT AND CATASTROPHIC. Any automatic YoY EPS calculation off screener's quarterly table returns roughly -98.5% ('earnings collapsed 98%') for a company whose filed EPS actually grew +20.6% YoY (3.04 vs 2.52) and whose PAT grew +37.8%. A screener, an alert, or an agent summarising 'EPS trend' inverts the sign of the story.
unrestated_historical_eps.detection_rule: Any per-share series where consecutive periods differ by more than ~10x is a restatement artefact, not a business event. Cross-check against the paid-up capital line in the same filing (193.62 -> 376.91 INR million) before believing it.

groww_stale_quarter.detail: Groww publishes, under the label 'Jun '26', Revenue INR 1,284 Cr (+31.89% YoY) and Net Profit INR 96.25 Cr (+39.10% YoY). The company's FILED consolidated Q1 FY27 is Revenue INR 1,446.4 Cr (+49.7%) and PAT INR 132.7 Cr (+37.8%). Groww's profit figure of 96.25 crore is, to within rounding, the Q1 FY26 PAT of INR 962.50 million (96.25 crore) - the YEAR-AGO quarter, presented under the current quarter's label.
groww_stale_quarter.consequence: Understates the latest quarter's profit by 27.5% and revenue by 11.2%, and propagates into every Groww-derived ratio on the page (EPS TTM 19.40, P/E 81.22, ROE 16.29%). A user comparing the app against Groww would conclude the APP is wrong.
groww_stale_quarter.note: This is the canonical 'stale aggregator page' trap and here it is provable against a primary filing rather than merely suspected.

encumbrance_nil_vs_42pct.detail: Two SAST filings made on 2026-08-19 about the SAME 87,632,093 shares state opposite things. The Reg 31(1) filing by the promoter (BC Asia Investments XV/XVI) reports 'Promoter holding already encumbered: NIL / NIL', type of encumbrance 'NA', and states verbatim 'There is no direct encumbrance on the shares of the TC. Pursuant to the Indirect Encumbrance, 100% of the shares of the Promoter and Guarantor are encumbered.' The Reg 29(1) filing by Deutsche Bank AG the same day reports line (d) 'Shares in the nature of encumbrance (pledge/lien/non-disposal undertaking/others): 87,632,093 / 42.84% / 42.41%'.
encumbrance_nil_vs_42pct.consequence: pledged_pct_of_promoter is 0% or 51.75% depending entirely on which of two same-day exchange filings the pipeline reads. screener.in and Groww show NO pledge line at all for this stock, so both silently report the 0% branch. For a leveraged-PE-owned promoter with a 42.8% stake charged to an 11-bank syndicate, 'no pledge' is a materially misleading answer to 'is the promoter pledged?'.
encumbrance_nil_vs_42pct.structure: The security is a limited-recourse Mauritian fixed-and-floating charge created 2025-03-17 by BC Asia Investments XXIII Limited over the SHARES OF the promoter entities, not over the listed company's shares. It was reportable only once the target listed - hence the 2026-08-19 filing for a 2025-03-17 event.
encumbrance_nil_vs_42pct.honest_answer: Both, with the structure named. 'No direct pledge on company shares; 42.84% of capital is indirectly encumbered via a charge over the promoter entity, held by Deutsche Bank AG as security agent for an 11-bank syndicate.'

standalone_default_scope.detail: screener.in's DEFAULT URL for this scrip is standalone, which captures only 43% of group PAT. See consolidated_vs_standalone_note. Produces P/E 166 vs ~73.

fiftytwo_week_window_is_33_days.detail: The 52-week low (INR 1,130.50) is dated 2026-08-17 - the listing date itself. The 'range' spans 33 calendar days. Printing '52-week high/low' is a false claim about the observation window, and any relative-strength or '% off highs' ranking silently compares a 33-day range against peers' 365-day ranges.

prelisting_share_count_in_filed_eps.detail: The filed EPS of INR 3.04 (standalone Q1 FY27) is computed on the paid-up capital at 2026-06-30 = 188,470,000 shares. The IPO fresh issue of 16,080,445 shares was allotted 2026-08-13, after the reporting date. Dividing today's price by a filed EPS therefore uses a share count 8.5% below the actual current count. Correct current-basis EPS TTM is INR 21.17, not INR 22.98.

total_income_vs_revenue.detail: chittorgarh reports FY26 'Total Income INR 4,563.70 Cr'; screener reports FY26 'Sales INR 4,525 Cr'. Both are right: 45,637.00 million is total income (revenue + other income) and 45,249.55 million is revenue from operations. The INR 38.7 crore gap is other income. A differ comparing 'revenue' across these two sources flags a false mismatch unless it knows which line each source publishes.

ofs_vs_fresh_issue.detail: The INR 3,067 crore issue is 54% offer-for-sale (INR 1,667 crore to selling shareholders) and only INR 1,400 crore fresh. Treating the headline issue size as capital raised overstates the cash that reached the company by 119%.

cin_still_unlisted.detail: The CIN printed on the 2026-09-04 filed results, U31300PN1998PLC131629, still carries the 'U' (unlisted) prefix; the company filed a CIN/listing-status change intimation on 2026-09-12. Any registry join keyed on CIN will find the company under its unlisted CIN in filings dated up to 2026-09-04 and under a new 'L' CIN afterwards. A CIN is not a stable key across a listing event.

attachlive_vs_attachhis.detail: Announcement PDFs resolve under two directories and the API does not indicate which. Lowercase-GUID names -> /xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/; uppercase-underscore names (used for exchange-received SAST disclosures) 404 there and resolve only under /xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/. Verified: 436B7797_..._153535.pdf returns HTTP 404 on AttachLive and HTTP 200 (1,188,844 bytes) on AttachHis. A fetcher hardcoding AttachLive loses precisely the encumbrance and substantial-acquisition filings.

nse_blocks_non_browser_clients.detail: nseindia.com returns HTTP 302 on the quote page bootstrap and HTTP 403 (Akamai 'Access Denied', reference #18.9fdc55b8) on /api/quote-equity even with a browser User-Agent, Referer, X-Requested-With and a cookie jar seeded from the site. BSE's api.bseindia.com answered every request with HTTP 200 under the same conditions. Any NSE-primary data path degrades to nothing for this name while the BSE path works.

company_name_typo_in_own_filing.detail: The company's own 2026-09-04 press-release announcement headline on BSE reads 'Dhoot Tranmission Limited' (missing the 's'). Exact-name matching against announcement headlines fails on the company's own filing.

intra_exchange_price_disagreement.detail: BSE's getScripHeaderData (LTP 1590.55, High 1604.15) and StockReachGraph (CurrVal 1588.15, HighVal 1610) disagree for the same scrip and session. Picking 'the exchange' as a source is not sufficient; the endpoint matters.

founding_year_conflict.detail: The company's own press release says 'Founded in 1999'; its CIN encodes 1998 and Trendlyne states 28 April 1998. The company contradicts its own registration on its own letterhead.

press_release_dateline_vs_registered_off.detail: Results are datelined 'Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar' while the registered office is at Chakan, Pune. Extracting company location from a press-release dateline puts it in the wrong district. Note also that Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar is itself a renamed city (formerly Aurangabad) - a second rename trap on the same string.

duplicate_announcement.detail: Two announcements filed 2026-08-28 carry the identical headline 'Investment in the step-down subsidiaries of the Company' with different NEWSIDs and different attachments. Deduplicating announcements on (date, headline) silently drops a genuine second filing.
